description: Carte des risques retrait-gonflement des argiles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mes Aides Réno. The publisher named on the listing is Mes Aides Réno. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PMTILES. The listing shows 2025-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
